data.long_description:
Experience contemporary living in this elegant 1-bedroom apartment at Samana Barari Heights, Majan. Spanning 841 sq. ft., this beautifully designed residence offers modern interiors, generous living spaces, and premium finishes. Located in the rapidly growing Majan community, the property provides a perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and connectivity, making it an excellent choice for both homeowners and investors.

Property Details:

1 Spacious Bedroom
2 Modern Bathrooms
Size: 841 Sq. Ft.
Bright Open-Plan Living and Dining Area
Contemporary Kitchen with High-Quality Finishes
Built-in Wardrobes
Private Balcony
Floor-to-Ceiling Windows
Dedicated Covered Parking
Premium Finishing Throughout

Property Amenities:

Resort-Style Swimming Pool
Fully Equipped Fitness Center
Children's Play Area
Landscaped Gardens
Outdoor Leisure Deck
Jacuzzi
BBQ Area
Multi-Purpose Hall
High-Speed Elevators
24/7 Security & CCTV
Covered Parking
Retail Shops and Cafés Within the Community

Location Highlights:

Located in Samana Barari Heights, Majan
Easy access to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311) and Al Ain Road (E66)
Minutes from Global Village
Close to IMG Worlds of Adventure
Near Dubai Miracle Garden and Dubai Butterfly Garden
Approximately 20 minutes to Downtown Dubai
Approximately 25 minutes to Dubai International Airport
Close to schools, supermarkets, healthcare facilities, and daily conveniences
